terms.title: Umuryango Terms & Charter
terms.subtitle: Please review how Umuryango protects shared family records and governance.
terms.section1_body: Every contribution, expense, payment, and communal project record is scoped to your family workspace with clear member attribution.
terms.section2_body: Monetary amounts are stored in exact integer minor units with a transparent history of who recorded or approved each action.
terms.section3_body: Permitted actions created offline are queued locally and synchronized idempotently so retries never duplicate financial records.
terms.section4_body: Members agree to protect their PIN or password and respect family role permissions set by the family administrator.
terms.back_prompt: Want to review your details first?
